summary: Snowboarder stuck on a snowy cliffside on Berthoud Pass; GCSAR lowered a rescuer ~180 ft on ropes through sugary unstable snow beneath 40-degree avalanche slopes; rescuer harnessed the subject and the two climbed back up the slope to safety; uninjured. Same Friday, GCSAR also answered a possible-burial call after a backcountry traveler found a solo skier's parked vehicle with a note plus fresh slide signs; dog teams confirmed no burial and the solo skier returned to his vehicle safely later that day
